mechanism.claim: Repeated migration of BTC quote participation toward spot or perpetual across six consecutive canonical confirmation intervals, confirmed by same-sign spot aggressive flow, identifies durable cash sponsorship or leverage withdrawal; follow the migration side for six elapsed hours.
mechanism.side: strict sign of spot participation share S6-S1 when cumulative spot aggressive flow has the same sign
mechanism.why_distinct: CLCS uses the ordered six-step path of spot share over irregular block-confirmation intervals. It is not a fixed-window spot/perp ratio, ticket size, price return, VWAP, funding, premium, OI, block throughput, or a component/stale/direction diagnostic.
mechanism.volatile_market_target: during rapid repricing, sponsorship repeated across confirmation intervals separates sustained cash migration from one leveraged burst; causal RV20 q90 remains only a later audit
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: height-modulo anchors, six irregular block intervals, path monotonicity, and q90 onset form a sparse asynchronous clock

features.anchor: canonical height H divisible by 36; ladder is blocks H through H+6
features.ladder_intervals: six strictly increasing header-timestamp intervals (H+k-1,H+k], each 60 to 1800 seconds
features.completed_minutes: for each interval use exact complete UTC minutes whose opens are >=ceil(left/60)*60 and whose closes are <=floor(right/60)*60; both spot and perpetual rows exact and coherent
features.spot_share: S_k=sum spot quote volume/(sum spot quote volume+sum perpetual quote volume), denominator positive
features.path_confirmation: at least four of the five increments S_(k+1)-S_k have strict sign sign(M); zero increments do not count
features.prior_ranks: strict-prior midrank of abs(M) over at most 168 prior valid anchors, minimum 112, current excluded
features.eligible_state: abs(M) rank>=0.90, path confirmation true, cumulative sum(F_k) strict sign equals sign(M), and abs(sum(F_k))>0
features.onset: current eligible state true and immediately preceding valid anchor state false; invalid anchors preserve prior valid state
features.confirmation: block H+6 is contained before signal availability
features.raw_availability: prefix maximum header timestamp and mediantime through H+6 plus 7200 seconds
features.decision: raw availability ceiled to the next exact five-minute UTC boundary D
features.source_valid: contiguous canonical chain, exact aligned spot/perpetual minutes, positive finite OHLC and nonnegative finite flow fields, no imputation

rv20_stress_slice.rv20: sqrt(365*mean exact daily returns^2 over t-20 through t-1)
rv20_stress_slice.threshold: numpy linear q90 over 756 strictly prior available RV20 observations
rv20_stress_slice.future_use: only after all sequential full-calendar stages pass

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not an input; exact realized funding only after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final
post_stage_volatility_audit.persistent_long_vol_comparator: same accepted clock and 0.5 gross, side forced long
post_stage_volatility_audit.rv20_q90_decomposition: same decomposition on causal RV20 q90 decisions

definitions.endpoint_share_only: abs(S6-S1) rank>=0.90 and flow sign agrees, without path confirmation
definitions.path_without_flow: rank and path confirmation without cumulative spot-flow sign
definitions.one_anchor_stale_ladder: primary valid-anchor state and side shifted one anchor before onset

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no block predicate, threshold, confirmation, embargo, side, clock, hold, RV20, subset, comparator, control, or gate repair
